name: INSSAVE - Save Instagram & Fb story
description:
Download stories from Instagram, Facebook and also save videos or photos. Run desktop version Instagram with all functions.

This very simple INSSAVE Edge extension for downloading videos and photos or stories from Facebook and Instagram with one click
and also allows you to access to the Instagram mobile website like you can do on your smartphone but on your computer!    

Just click on the extension icon in the toolbar (in the upper right corner of the browser) and get all the functions like in the mobile app.

☑️ Download videos and stories from Facebook
One of the key highlights of our extension is its seamless one-click video download feature for Facebook. Whether it's a fleeting yet memorable story from your friends or a favorite page, this extension allows you to save Facebook stories effortlessly in just seconds.

☑️ Download videos and stories from Instagram
Instagram is renowned for its stunning photos and videos, and our extension makes downloading them effortless. Whether it's a captivating image or an inspiring short clip, you can save them all with just one click, ensuring you always have access to the content you love.

- Upload your photos or videos 
- Direct Messages are fully supported
- Open / Download photos and videos in full HD
- Everything you can do normally on your phone on the Instagram mobile website (like, follow, comment, browse, ..)
- Comfortable layout for a better experience

This app requires only the minimal permissions required to work to improve your security.
